text:
lee: Rolling v3.1.2 -> eu-west-1 canary. Quick smoke (tokenization + heartbeats) kicked off, will watch 10m.

deploy-bot: canary shift to 2% applied. readiness ok. invoking smoke-short suite.

sylvia: Starting short-suite: `./smoke/run --quick --region=eu-west-1 --checks=tok,heartbeat`

ops-bot: short-suite interim: 12/12 ok, p50=32ms p95=90ms errors=0.

infra-bot: noticed small backlog on kv-cache-writer on canary hosts at 09:41:22 UTC, queue depth spike 4x baseline. No pod restarts.

sylvia: Sample logs:
```
09:41:20 kv-writer-eu-1 req=aa1 enq=12 dq=2
09:41:22 kv-writer-eu-1 req=aa2 enq=48 dq=7
09:41:24 kv-writer-eu-2 req=aa3 enq=10 dq=1
```

lee: Hmm. That could cause tail latency blips. Proposal: hold ramp, pin embed/noncritical routes in eu-west-1 to v3.1.1, keep canary at 2% for 20m while we flush queues. If queue depth normalizes and smoke remains green -> proceed. If persistent queue depth >3x for 5m or any 5xx -> rollback.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by lee. pin set: eu-west-1 -> v3.1.1 for noncritical routes at 2% until 3330005610.

infra-bot: mitigation: temporarily increase writer concurrency on canary hosts: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-writer CONCURRENCY=6 -n eu-west-1-canary` applied. Monitoring queue depth.

sylvia: Rerunning short-suite after mitigation. ETA ~6m.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: `alert:kv.writer.queue.depth > 3x for 5m` -> notify #oncall.

lee: Owners: infra-bot (mitigate), sylvia (smoke runs), ops-bot (alerts). Reconvene in 10m or on threshold.
